about: The achievement log (Passport > Exploration) and the town stamps (Passport > Town Stamps); guide: docs/guides/ACHIEVEMENTS.md. Code reports EVENTS with Achievements.shared().note(event) (scripts/learning/achievements.gd); an ACHIEVEMENT unlocks when its event has happened 'times' times (default 1). Names are phrases achievements.<id with dots as _> in data/phrases.json. Generated, not listed here: one 'game.<activity id>' per data/activities.json activity (event game.<id>: a session finished with its target reached) and one 'stamp.<id>' per entry of 'stamps' (event stamp.<id>: its coin collected, scripts/world/stamp_coin.gd). 'xp' is added once, when the achievement unlocks.

stamps._comment: One coin per id (user's spots, 21 Nov 2026; guide docs/guides/ACHIEVEMENTS.md#town-stamps). 'place': a data/town_map.json place (name phrase places.<place>). 'unit': the building unit that carries the coin. 'at': the coin's centre in TOWN coordinates (Apartment space, units of 1.3 m, +X west, +Z north); null = not placed, the stamp does not exist yet. 'parent' (optional): node path below the Apartment that carries it (a lift car). 'reach' (optional): pickup radius in metres. 'gate' (optional): node path below the Apartment of a hinged door the coin sits behind; collected only while it is open. 'face' (optional): a TOWN point the coin's face looks at; it then stands still instead of spinning (a spot too shallow for the spin, the bank safe). 'where': a note for people. Placed by scripts/world/stamp_places.gd.

supermarket.where: the storage room behind the staff door, far corner

bank.where: inside the round safe in the vault (opens with E)

taqueria.where: the kitchen behind the taco bar, corner by the comal

control_tower.where: inside the tower lift car (rides with it)

hospital.where: the roof, corner away from the helipad (inside the parapets, not reachable from the annex roof)

chapel.where: the belfry, up the ladder inside the tower

playground.where: top of the slide (the slide tower's deck)
